correctness.rationale: Independence gives at most one selection per rung. An empty endpoint or a pair of consecutive empty rungs leaves a vertex undominated. Between successive occupied rungs with no empty rung, independence forces opposite selected rails; across a single empty rung, domination of both vertices on that rung forces the same alternation condition. These three conditions are also sufficient. A first-rail choice and the z=n−k one-vacancy gaps among p=k−1 gaps therefore encode the states exactly. Since n≥2 requires k≥2, a vertical flip breaks alternation with at least one neighboring occupied rung, by independence or by domination according as the gap has size zero or one. A horizontal slide preserves feasibility exactly when it transfers a vacancy across an internal selected rung into an empty gap, hence swaps adjacent 01 and 10 and preserves the first-rail choice. This proves the two path-token components, including z=0,p. For their metric, sorted tokens cannot pass. Moving all left-going tokens in increasing order and then all right-going tokens in decreasing order attains the sum of absolute displacements; target positions are strictly increasing, so no intervening token blocks those moves. Opposite packed configurations attain z(p−z). Coordinatewise medians are strictly increasing and are the unique tuple in all three pairwise metric intervals. Each consecutive gap pair contributes binom(p−2,z−1) edges per copy in the nonsaturated range. Summing the binomial counts gives the two stated series (subtracting the n=1 term for vertices). At minimum size, z=p for odd n and z=p−1 for even n, yielding the stated singleton and path cases.
residual_risks: The scripts were inspected, not rerun. The direct checker tests original ladder subsets through n=10. The word checker through n=18 builds candidates from the gap encoding, not all ternary words, and its occupied-cell guard skips vertical flips (the proof rules them out). Its evidence is the adjacency comparison on the generated configurations.
The path-token checker goes through p=8 and checks median triples only when the number of states is at most 28. The universal assertions rely on the structural and metric proofs.

originality.rationale: Bounded pass for the all-cardinality structure theorem for the open ladder as a seed, especially the exact two-copy isomorphism and preservation of a first-rail phase under every legal slide. The unweighted maximal-independent-set count, known path-factor examples and standard grid/lattice metric consequences are not independent originality claims. The closest circular-ladder result uses a related gap construction but does not cover this open-boundary state space or all feasible open-ladder cardinalities.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact path-particle encoding or an open-ladder treatment under maximal-independent-set reconfiguration could affect priority. The bounded searches and comparisons do not establish historical exclusivity.

value.rationale: The result identifies every fixed-size state graph of a natural and widely used seed, not just its independent domination number or total static count. The explicit coordinate map decides reachability, constructs shortest legal sequences and identifies the exact obstructions to crossing components. This is a useful structural classification; the older Fibonacci total and standard consequences for path-token factors are not by themselves the contribution.
residual_risks: The results do not describe other ladders or moves that permit leaving the fixed-size independent-dominating state space.
